verdict.rationale: Docs show board/stockholder approvals are automatically integrated into workflows and tied to award agreements, FMV-based strike pricing (with override option), predefined vesting schedules, and Gusto integration that can auto-grant equity from offer-letter promises — covering the core founder journey of approving and issuing a compliant option grant to a new hire. 409A compliance is supported via third-party valuation providers feeding FMV into the grant workflow rather than a single in-house step. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the full flow, and a concrete example specifically for a 'new hire' offer-to-grant scenario end-to-end.
